applicable.title: Checkpoint validation must succeed from a detached checkout of the checkpoint tag
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category checkpoint; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Validate the checkpoint from a clean clone detached at its own tag, not only on the branch.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A recorded validate_checkpoint.py run from a detached checkout returning CHECKPOINT_VALID.

applicable.title: A file inventory must be recomputed from the repository, never trusted as an assertion
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category checkpoint; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Declare every changed path with a reason before finalizing and let the tooling bind the hashes.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A FILES.json whose declared change set matches the recomputed one, proven by a passing validation.

applicable.title: Every operation attempt must be auditable, including a refusal decided before execution
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category checkpoint; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that a refused operation appends its attempt to the ledger before returning an error.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A ledger record with result PRECONDITION_REJECTED, a result code and a failure reason.

applicable.title: A checkpoint may never claim readiness while it also claims to be blocked
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category checkpoint; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Verify that the checkpoint carries no blocker while it claims to be ready for review.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A passing validation with blockedBy empty at a readiness status.

applicable.title: A PASS requires evidence that can be executed or resolved, not a statement
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category quality; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Attach a resolvable evidence reference to every PASS recorded by this Gate.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A validation run confirming that every PASS reference resolves.

applicable.title: The repository must be self-contained; a specification may not live outside it
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category documentation; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every specification this Gate depends on is committed to the repository.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A passing documentation link and checklist test.

applicable.title: Independent validation cannot be declared by the run that did the work
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category process; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Close the implementing run at an internal status and leave the independent verdict pending.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A checkpoint whose independentReview and redTeam are PENDING at handoff.

applicable.title: Requirement completeness must be total and evidence-backed before handoff
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category process; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Extract every requirement before implementing and audit completeness before handoff.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A completeness report with total coverage and total evidence coverage.

applicable.title: A red gate requires rework, never a waiver, and never a weakened check
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category testing; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Run the Green Keeper until every mandatory gate is green, repairing causes rather than checks.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A rework log whose last cycle is GREEN with zero remaining failures.

applicable.title: A recorded command must carry runtime, working directory, commit and purpose to be replayable
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category tooling; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Record commands with the tooling so each one is executable from its declared working directory.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A validation run over a ledger whose commands all resolve.

applicable.title: A control over a checkpoint's own evidence must be scoped to the moment it matters
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category tooling; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Check whether any new control would be invalidated by the evidence its own run produces.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A passing validation executed by the gate harness itself.

applicable.title: Sealed checkpoints and their tags are immutable, and tooling must keep validating them
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category git; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every sealed checkpoint still validates under the tooling this Gate changes.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A passing historical compatibility run over every sealed tag.

applicable.title: An installed capability must be detected by resolved path, not by a bare command lookup
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category environment; severity MEDIUM; status CONFIRMED, so it is not yet prevented automatically
applicable.requiredCheck: When this Gate records a capability, resolve the executable path before concluding anything about availability.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A capability record naming the resolved path, or a justification that this Gate detects no capability.

applicable.title: Evidence must be recorded as it happens, not reconstructed at the end of a run
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category process; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Record each command through the tooling while the work happens.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A ledger whose records were produced by the recording tooling during the run.

applicable.title: Every positive terminal status needs one shared promotion invariant
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category quality; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every positive terminal status this Gate can produce is covered by the shared promotion invariant, not only the status this delivery ends at.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A table-driven validation run that exercises every positive status against every mandatory red dimension.

applicable.title: A mandatory set must be closed by policy, never chosen by the caller
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category testing; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every control whose scope could be narrowed by an argument derives that scope from policy instead.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A recorded gate run whose requiredGates equal the canonical mandatory set, with a successful command for each one.

applicable.title: A completeness denominator must come from a source the delivery does not own
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category process; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that the expected requirement set is derived independently and compared as a set, not only as a count.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A completeness report whose expected and declared identifier sets are equal.

applicable.title: A structured reference must be resolved, not merely well typed
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category tooling; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every reference this Gate records is resolved by a tool, not accepted as a string.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A validation run that rejects a nonexistent control, a nonexistent evidence path and a nested secret.

applicable.title: A derived artifact must carry a fingerprint of the inputs that produced it
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category tooling; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every derived artifact this Gate stores can be recomputed and is recomputed during validation.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A validation run that rejects a preflight whose inputs have changed.

applicable.title: Evidence produced from a dirty tree needs immutable input identity
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category tooling; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every recorded command binds its inputs by content and that no timestamp in the ledger is later than the recorded end of the run.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A validation run over a ledger whose records all carry an input digest, with a post-commit validation record at the sealed commit.

applicable.title: Sealed history needs an anchor outside the content it describes
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category git; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that the integrity chain still resolves for every sealed checkpoint and that this Gate anchors every sealed predecessor.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A verification run over the anchor chain returning no divergence.

applicable.title: An authoritative count must be derived once, never maintained by hand twice
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category documentation; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every count used as evidence in this Gate is derived from one source and verified where it is quoted.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A validation run that rejects a report whose stated count contradicts the derived one.

applicable.title: A lesson must cite a source that actually records the finding it claims
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category documentation; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every lesson this Gate writes or updates cites a checkpoint that records the finding identifier it names.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A memory validation run that resolves every lesson source locator.

applicable.title: A control is finished only when its positive path has been executed, not only its refusals
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category quality; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: For every control this Gate adds or changes that gates a status, execute the path that reaches the status, not only the paths that are refused.
applicable.requiredEvidence: An executed positive-path test or simulation artifact for each such control.

applicable.title: A generic guardrail derives repository state instead of naming today's checkpoint
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category testing; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that no generic guard, test or policy in this Gate names a historical checkpoint to decide behaviour, and that any such rule is derived from repository state.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A derived exclusion with a test proving it moves, or a documented fixture that names a concrete checkpoint on purpose.

applicable.title: An adversarial battery without a null-mutation control proves nothing
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category testing; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Run every adversarial battery of this Gate with an unmutated control through the same path, and record its result with the battery.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A Red Team report whose baselineControl is VALID.

applicable.title: A lesson's prose may record a residual limit but may never contradict its status
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category documentation; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every lesson this Gate writes or updates describes limits rather than restating its own status.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A memory validation run with no status contradiction reported.

applicable.title: A configuration key that no code reads is a defect, not documentation
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category tooling; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every configuration key this Gate declares is read by the implementation, or remove it and document the fixed behaviour.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A validated policy document whose every key has a consumer.

applicable.title: A required protocol transition must never turn a mandatory gate red
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category process; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Before handoff, execute the protocol transitions this Gate's successor will perform and confirm the mandatory gates stay green.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A successor durability artifact whose every state is green.

applicable.title: The lesson preflight presumes an implementing delivery and constrains an audit run badly
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category process; severity LOW; status CONFIRMED, so it is not yet prevented automatically
applicable.requiredCheck: When this run audits rather than implements, record which derived requirements describe the audit role and which describe an implementing delivery.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A preflight whose scope names the audit role, or a recorded justification.
